snippet.title: Vespera Bononia - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
We are thrilled to announce our action-roguelite 𝐕𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚 𝐁𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐚 is OUT NOW!
Watch the official trailer and buy it now on Steam.

Survive the nightmare!
Fight fast in this action-roguelite. Instantly switch between four souls to unleash devastating combos. Master evasive maneuvers; run, jump, and dodge the bullet hell. Crawl through procedural dungeons, collect Effigies, and craft your build.

Conquer grotesque bosses and unveil the secrets of a shifting city in Vespera Bononia!

Buy now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2843680/Vespera_Bononia/

Follow on our social media
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/power.up.publishing/
